pdf.title: HTTP Security Audit Report
pdf.note: The grade weights the criticality of each check and the quality of the configured value: a header that is present but weak loses points. A missing header does not by itself imply an exploitable vulnerability; it must be assessed together with the rest of the server configuration.
about.title: Giới thiệu
check.https.name: HTTPS required (HTTP redirect)
check.https.desc: Checks that the site does not serve content over unencrypted HTTP and that it redirects to HTTPS.
check.tls.name: TLS encryption and certificate validity
check.tls.desc: Evaluates the negotiated TLS version, whether obsolete versions are accepted and the days left on the certificate.
check.cookies.name: Secure cookies (Secure / HttpOnly / SameSite)
check.cookies.desc: Prevents cookies from travelling unencrypted, being readable by JavaScript or being sent in cross-site requests.
check.cors.name: CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin)
check.cors.desc: Controls which external pages can read the server responses from the browser.
check.strict-transport-security.name: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
check.strict-transport-security.desc: Forces encrypted HTTPS connections, preventing Man-in-the-Middle attacks.
check.content-security-policy.name: Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
check.content-security-policy.desc: Prevents malicious code injection such as Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and unauthorised data.
check.x-frame-options.name: X-Frame-Options
check.x-frame-options.desc: Protects the website against Clickjacking by preventing unauthorised loading in iframes.
check.x-content-type-options.name: X-Content-Type-Options
check.x-content-type-options.desc: Disables MIME-Sniffing, forcing the browser to respect the declared content type.
check.referrer-policy.name: Referrer-Policy
check.referrer-policy.desc: Controls and limits the leak of sensitive information sent in outgoing links.
check.permissions-policy.name: Permissions-Policy
check.permissions-policy.desc: Restricts unauthorised browser access to hardware features (camera, microphone, GPS).
check.cross-origin-opener-policy.name: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP)
check.cross-origin-opener-policy.desc: Isolates the window browsing context from other external documents.
check.cross-origin-embedder-policy.name: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy (COEP)
check.cross-origin-embedder-policy.desc: Prevents a page from loading cross-origin resources that have not explicitly allowed it. Not required on normal websites.
check.cache-control.name: Cache-Control
check.cache-control.desc: Controls caching policies to prevent leaks of sensitive data.
aviso.hsts.http: HSTS only protects HTTPS connections and the site was queried over HTTP.
aviso.hsts.no_max_age: It does not declare max-age; browsers ignore the policy.
aviso.hsts.short: max-age is shorter than 6 months (15552000 or more recommended).
aviso.hsts.no_subdomains: It does not include includeSubDomains; subdomains are not protected.
aviso.csp.inline_eval: Allows both 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'; this greatly reduces XSS protection.
aviso.csp.eval: Allows 'unsafe-eval'; it allows executing code generated at runtime.
aviso.csp.wildcard: It includes the '*' wildcard and accepts resources from any origin.
aviso.xfo.allowfrom: ALLOW-FROM is no longer supported by modern browsers; use CSP frame-ancestors.
aviso.xfo.invalid: Unrecognised value; it should be DENY or SAMEORIGIN.
aviso.xcto.not_nosniff: The only valid value is nosniff.
aviso.referrer.unsafe: unsafe-url sends the full URL to external sites.
aviso.permissions.wildcard: The '*' wildcard leaves features open to any origin.
aviso.coop.unsafe_none: unsafe-none does not isolate the window from other origins.
aviso.coep.unsafe_none: unsafe-none allows loading cross-origin resources without explicit permission.
aviso.cache.permissive: It allows caching the response; review it if sensitive content is served.
aviso.tls.obsolete: The negotiated TLS version is obsolete; TLS 1.2 or higher should be used.
aviso.tls.legacy: The server accepts TLS 1.0/1.1 handshakes; it should reject obsolete versions.
aviso.tls.expiring: The certificate expires in less than 30 days.
aviso.cookies.no_secure: Some cookies would also be sent over unencrypted HTTP.
aviso.cookies.no_httponly: Some cookies are readable from JavaScript (risk if XSS exists).
aviso.cookies.no_samesite: Some cookies lack SameSite; they can travel in requests from other sites (CSRF).
aviso.cors.wildcard_credentials: Allows any origin with credentials: any website could read authenticated data.
aviso.cors.wildcard: Allows any origin (*); review whether it exposes private information.
aviso.https.insecure: All traffic travels unencrypted and can be read or modified.
aviso.https.no_redirect: The content is also served unencrypted; force the HTTPS redirect.
